detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

NAD⁺ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide)

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (oxidized form)
  • Molecular Formula: C21H26N6O14P2
  • Molecular Weight: 648.4 g/mol
  • Structure: Dinucleotide composed of nicotinamide and adenine linked via phosphate groups
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

NAD⁺ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is a naturally occurring coenzyme present in all living cells and plays a fundamental role in cellular redox reactions. In laboratory environments, NAD⁺ is widely used in biochemical and molecular research to study metabolic pathways, enzymatic reactions, and cellular energy transfer mechanisms.

This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, intended to support controlled experimental use and analytical consistency.

Research Applications:
  • Investigation of redox reactions and electron transfer processes
  • Study of cellular metabolism and enzymatic activity in vitro
  • Evaluation of coenzyme-dependent biochemical pathways
  • Comparative research involving metabolic cofactors in laboratory models
Storage and Handling:
  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Maintain sterile handling practices during research use
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Concentration: 50 mg/mL
  • Total Content: 1500 mg per bottle
  • Volume: 30 mL
  • Delivery Format: Metered liquid solution
  • Dispenses per Container: ~200
  • Amount per Dispense: ~7.5 mg
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications
Compliance Notice:

NAD⁺ is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
